card.name: The first name Thomas before surnames
card.fires_on: The first name Thomas, usually right before a surname such as Jefferson, Hardy or Aquinas. It also fires on the word Double at the start of a name or title.

modes.label: Thomas before a surname
modes.description: The first name Thomas starts a person's full name in a biographical, citation or list setting.

modes.label: Double starting a name
modes.description: The word Double begins a product or model name such as Double-Take or Double Slit.

card.writes: It likely suppresses unrelated continuations after the name, with no clear promoted word, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the first name Thomas when a surname is about to follow, as in a person's full name.
